bullets: DUAL AIR FRYER WITH 2 BASKETS: Cook food faster and more conveniently with two powerful air fryers in one with a combined 6-quart large air fryer capacity
VERSATILE COOKING OPTIONS: Dual zone air fryer technology gives you the flexibility to cook different dishes simultaneously, or to easily switch from one basket to the other
FOOD FINISHES TOGETHER: Convenient Sync Finish allows individual 3-quart large capacity air fryer double baskets to finish cooking at the same time
WIDE TEMPERATURE RANGE: Digital air fryer dual basket temperature settings from 200-450°F allow you to cook at low and high heat for food just the way you want it
HEALTHY FOOD PREP: Enjoy all your favorite fried foods without sacrificing flavor or quality; this dual basket air fryer convection oven requires little to no oil for healthier frying results
LARGE VIEWING WINDOWS: Effortlessly monitor and observe your air-fryer oven's cooking progress, ensuring perfect doneness and precision every single time
EASY CLEANUP: The removable, non-stick coated air fryer dual baskets are dishwasher safe and easy to clean after every use
AIR FRY ALL YOUR FAVORITES: Perfectly cook chicken, vegetables, pizza, French fries, frozen foods, and even leftovers with touchscreen presets in minutes
SLEEK COUNTERTOP DESIGN: The compact air fryer size and sleek convection oven countertop design will seamlessly fit in with your other home kitchen appliances, apartment, or dorm decor
